prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated transparent PNG game effect for a 2D side-view fighting game: the ground-travelling hammer shockwave of the Bogeyman from Silent Hill: Downpour.

Source observation for this specific effect: the Prima Games St. Maria's Monastery guide image 02i-084 shows a linear wake of muted dirty gray and brown dust, small chips and jagged dark floor cracks extending away from the hammer. It is a physical dusty ground disturbance. Translate that observed effect into a compact single static sprite in side elevation, travelling from LEFT to RIGHT. Show one low leading burst of turbulent gray-beige dust on the right, a short thinner fading dust wake extending left, with only a few small dark debris chips. A restrained broken black fissure at the base may support the ground contact. Keep the silhouette low and wide, grounded on one clear flat baseline near the lower part of the canvas. The darkest particulate core should remain readable at tiny game scale; feather the outer dust with real alpha translucency.

Composition: ONE effect only, approximately 3:1 wide horizontal canvas, entire effect fully inside the image with at least 12% transparent safety margin on every side. No character, no hammer, no hands, no terrain tile, no floor plane, no rocks larger than small chips, no scene, no perspective background. No glowing ring, no magical glyph, no colored energy, no fire, no blue or purple aura. Do not add a long row of separate explosions. No UI, no text, no labels, no border, no signature. Real transparent background, never a checkerboard baked into pixels. Mature atmospheric survival-horror rendering, muted realistic material and fine smoke texture, not cartoon. This is one authored static candidate sprite, not an animation sheet.
